scene: The clockwork canary sings, unfolding the wall into a busy transport balcony.
picture: Flat side view of an open-air balcony. On the far left, a woven bamboo cable car waits with open gate. The player stands centre on skates. Up high, a round paper-lantern balloon floats tethered to a cleat. On the far right sits a spherical neon-striped bowling-ball monorail car on a rail.
shown: A woven bamboo cable car parked at the dock on the far left.
A glowing paper-lantern hot air balloon tethered up high above the centre.
A giant hollow bowling-ball monorail car waiting along tracks on the far right.
